summary: BingEx Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 21, 2026, containing a press release announcing its first quarter 2026 financial results. The filing reports revenues of RMB935.3 million, gross profit of RMB105.8 million, and a net loss of RMB42.6 million, along with operational metrics like 57.9 million orders fulfilled. The press release includes commentary from management on performance, AI adoption, and strategic initiatives. No terms of a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change are present. The filing is a routine earnings release, which does not qualify as a special situation.
